common.tagline: Pirate-haven moon at a key intersection of Outer Rim hyperlanes.
common.government: None — pirate captaincies in loose confederation
common.famousFor: Pirates, smugglers, and the kind of cantinas where the Imperial Navy declines to follow.
common.cantinaReputation: Moon at the edge of the Rishi Maze. A listening outpost and small settlement cling to the rocky coast. In 15 BBY, Rishi is a waypoint for ships heading to or from the Corporate Sector. The cantina at Rishi Station serves terrible food but has reliable fuel pumps and mechanics who don't ask questions.
